user.title: Connect an existing MyMeter session
user.description: Experimental only: PSE&G My Account SSO and SMS/email verification are NOT supported yet. Enter the Cookie header VALUE from a successful logged-in ChartData request in YOUR OWN Home Assistant instance. This is a sensitive session credential. The integration does not accept your account password.

reauth_confirm.title: MyMeter session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in to MyMeter using your browser, then enter a fresh Cookie header VALUE from a successful ChartData request in your Home Assistant instance.

error.invalid_cookie: Enter a valid Cookie header value (not headers, HAR or cURL)
error.cannot_connect: Connection or timeout error contacting MyMeter.
error.login_redirect: MyMeter redirected the request, likely to the sign-in flow. The browser cookie cannot be reused this way.
error.access_denied: MyMeter returned HTTP 401/403. The cookie was rejected or the request is missing required authentication.
error.non_json: MyMeter returned text/HTML rather than JSON. This may be a login page or an incompatible browser request.
error.chart_settings: MyMeter returned JSON, but not 15-minute Consumption (kWh) readings. Check the chart selection in MyMeter.
error.server_error: MyMeter returned an unexpected HTTP status or unusually large response.

abort.already_configured: This MyMeter account is already configured
